description: This file defines a PHP class 'PHPUnit_TestCase' that acts as an adapter for PEAR PHPUnit test cases to be used with SimpleTest, including various assertion methods and compatibility functions.

classes.name: PHPUnit_TestCase
classes.description: Adapter class for PEAR PHPUnit test cases to work with SimpleTest framework, providing various assertion methods and configuration options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the test case with an optional label and sets loose typing to false.

methods.name: assertEquals
methods.description: Asserts equality between two values, using loose or strict comparison based on configuration.

methods.name: assertNotNull
methods.description: Asserts that a value is not null.

methods.name: assertNull
methods.description: Asserts that a value is null.

methods.name: assertSame
methods.description: Asserts that two object references point to the same object.

methods.name: assertNotSame
methods.description: Asserts that two object references do not point to the same object.

methods.name: assertTrue
methods.description: Asserts that a condition is true.

methods.name: assertFalse
methods.description: Asserts that a condition is false.

methods.name: assertRegExp
methods.description: Asserts that a string matches a regex pattern.

methods.name: assertType
methods.description: Asserts that a value is of a specified type.

methods.name: setLooselyTyped
methods.description: Configures whether equality assertions use loose comparison.

methods.name: countTestCases
methods.description: Returns the number of test cases, typically for progress indication.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the label or name of the test case.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Dummy method for setting the name; does nothing.
